weapon.d: Grants Atk+3. If foe initiates combat or if foe's HP = 100% at start of combat, grants Atk/Res+6 during combat, and also, if foe uses magic, reduces damage from attacks during combat and from area-of-effect Specials by 50% (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials).

assist.d:
Grants another action to target ally.
(Cannot target an ally with Sing or Dance.)

a.d: If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+3 during combat.
If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+4 during combat.
If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+5 during combat.
If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Res+7 to unit and neutralizes unit's penalties to Atk/Res during combat.

b.d: Inflicts Atk/Res-1 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Atk/Res (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Res-2 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Atk/Res (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Res-3 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Atk/Res (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.

c.d: At start of turn, grants Res+2 to adjacent allies for 1 turn.
At start of turn, grants Res+3 to adjacent allies for 1 turn.
At start of turn, grants Res+4 to adjacent allies for 1 turn.
At start of turn, if unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Res+5 to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn.
